article: A 22-year-old man has died after a struggle with a Mountie at the RCMP detachment in Houston, between Prince George and Terrace.
RCMP said yesterday Ian Geoffrey Bush died after he "became very violent" at about 10 p.m. Saturday while an officer was trying to release him.
"A violent struggle [with the officer] ensued" and Bush died at the scene, said Cpl. Tom Seaman. The officer was injured but is recovering.

Seaman did not say how Bush died or whether the officer used his gun. He also did not say if there were witnesses or why Bush was in custody. The death is being investigated by the RCMP's North District major crime unit. An autopsy is being conducted.
